nodes.label: HackerRoom Monitor Screen Content Texture
nodes.description: Screenshot of a JavaScript/React Native code editor (VS Code) showing a welcome.tsx file from a JS Mastery course project. This is the display content mapped onto the virtual monitor screen surface inside the HackerRoom 3D scene, giving the illusion of an active coding workspace.
nodes.visual_content: Dark IDE screenshot showing JS Mastery logo, open files welcome.tsx and CustomButton.tsx, React Native JSX code with Swiper and SafeAreaView components — authentically simulates an active developer monitor
